cfa.rule: the CF-A single (wave6-fixtures.ts cfaArrangement: 56 bars, 134.4 s at 100 BPM, a bridge with an applied dominant and a borrowed iv, the last chorus a whole step up) played live in the editor: the whole song at 4× its tempo on a pack that answers every audio file 700 ms late, then the lifted chorus for 8 s at its own tempo. No audio underrun (AudioContext.playbackStats), no skipped or missing sound, no main-thread stall over 200 ms, no stretch of 300 ms under −50 dBFS while the song plays, an audio-thread peak load under 0.7 where Chrome reports renderCapacity; every sound the bridge and the last chorus bring decoded before its first bar; the lifted chorus offline faster than real time (the CPU headroom)

earlyJazz.rule: the first four bars of each CF-T standard's backing (src/early-jazz.ts) at 132 BPM, R0: brushes, two-beat upright and the right hand on 2 and 4 within 10 LU of each other, the bass no more than 6 LU under the piano; the mix between −32 and −14 LUFS; no peak at 0 dBFS

lift.rule: band.axis-4bar under a learner tune whose key plan rises a whole step at bar 2, bass and chords only, at 96 BPM: the worst high-frequency jump in the 150 ms after the change is no more than 3 dB over the same Band in one key at the same bar line; no 50 ms around the change falls 20 dB under the bar before it; no clipping

sevenths.rule: per sound and voicing (default dictionary, close stack from C3, left hand): two qualities a half step apart in one voice differ by more than −12 dB of the chord and sit within 3 LU of each other (an ear step compares them by their notes, not their level); the five qualities struck in turn (half a second each) within ±3 LU of the piano's phrase in the same voicing (±5 LU for the close stack from C3, low in every instrument's range); no peak at 0 dBFS. (A chord held alone for a second is not matched across sounds: the piano's E4–G4 samples decay 4–6 LU under its C4, so a held piano chord reads quieter than its phrase.)

velocity.rule: velocity is linear gain on every sound: .4 is −7.96 dB and .3 is −10.46 dB within ±0.3 dB; in U13.L02's hook (96 BPM: kick, snare, accented hats, finger bass, Rhodes; ghosts on the 'a' of 2, the 'e' of 3 and the 'a' of 4) each ghost note at .3 and at .4 carries more than −20 dB of everything else in its 60 ms and sits 6 dB or more under the backbeat
